address: Av. Veracruz 38, Roma Norte, Cuauhtémoc, 06700, Mexico
bio: With its terrace shaded by an awning and likable ambience, Hugo is the sort of place you'll want to return to time and again. While the wine list is indeed extensive, giving it its wine bar classification, it's not just about the bottles here; it's as equally well liked for its bistro-style menu. Quality products shine in dishes with pleasing presentations, while the contemporary cuisine remains faithful to traditional flavors....
